# Signal Screener

> A free crypto screener that scores any token on Quality, Opportunity and Risk using live
> public data, and publishes the data coverage behind every score. Where a figure cannot be
> verified it is excluded rather than estimated, and the page says what was missing.

Signal Screener is operated by Aidan Cassar, a sole trader in Malta. It runs entirely in the
browser: there is no account, no login, and no server storing user data. Scoring is free and
unlimited.

## What makes the scoring different

Most crypto screeners fill gaps with assumptions. This one does not. Every score carries a
coverage percentage stating how much of it is backed by verified data, and each report lists
what could not be measured and why. A high score at low coverage is explicitly flagged as a
weak result rather than a strong one.

Three scores are produced for every asset, using the same three core metrics so that any two
coins are directly comparable:

- **Quality** — adoption and liquidity (40%), tokenomics (35%), scale and depth (25%)
- **Opportunity** — price momentum (40%), adoption growth (35%), dilution headroom (25%)
- **Risk** — liquidity risk (50%), scale risk (30%), volatility risk (20%)

Market figures are reconciled by taking the median across up to four independent providers,
so a single bad feed cannot move a score.

## Data sources

- Market data: CoinGecko, CoinPaprika, CryptoCompare, Binance (median)
- Total value locked, protocol revenue, audit records: DefiLlama
- Developer activity: GitHub
- Holder concentration: Ethplorer (Ethereum tokens only)
- Price history: Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, CoinGecko, CoinPaprika

## What cannot be measured

No free public source rates founder track record or team quality, so it is excluded rather
than guessed. Audit status is available for listed DeFi protocols via DefiLlama but not for
base-layer networks. Validator concentration is public per chain but not in a single
comparable feed.

## Pages

- [Screener](https://www.signalscreener.app/): score any asset, free and unlimited
- [Reports](https://www.signalscreener.app/crypto-scores): researched write-ups by sector
- [Terms](https://www.signalscreener.app/?view=terms)
- [Privacy](https://www.signalscreener.app/?view=privacy)

## Reports

Each report explains what an asset does in plain language, sets out the case for it and what
to watch, and shows a score with its coverage. Editorial is written once by hand; only the
market figures update daily.

- [Bitcoin](https://www.signalscreener.app/coins/bitcoin)

## Important

Nothing here is financial advice. Scores are the mechanical output of a published framework
applied to public data. They take no account of any individual's circumstances and are not a
recommendation. Digital assets are volatile and can lose all of their value.
